summary.text: Donald Vermillion is the Libertarian candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 62, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a U.S. Army veteran and father.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Vermillion's military service as the U.S. Army from 1996 to 1998 and his profession as retired.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he experienced homelessness in Newark during 9/11, which shaped his commitment to supporting veterans and working families.

His survey answers list keeping tax dollars local in rural Colorado, opposing Front Range diversions of San Luis Valley water, and opposing automated license plate reader networks among his priorities.
